name: Real Estate

mofsl_2qfy27.headline: Resilient 2Q; FY27 guidance broadly maintained
mofsl_2qfy27.read: Pre-sales across MOFSL's 15-name universe rose 26% YoY to INR428b, but only 3% ex OBER (+604%, INR79b maiden NCR project); the top four contributed 56% against a 65% four-quarter average. Collections were INR258b (+14% YoY, collection efficiency 60%). Revenue rose 13% to INR180b, EBITDA 20% to INR48b (27% margin) and adjusted PAT 7% to INR44b. Misses were SIGNATUR and BRGD (pre-sales down 9-10%), ABREL fell 66% on no launches and DLF fell 12% but at INR38b beat estimates. Guidance: LODHA FY27 pre-sales INR240b on a INR191b 2H pipeline, BRGD INR90b, ABREL INR150b by FY29, DLF Mumbai P-2 launch in 3QFY27. Top picks LODHA, BRGD, ABREL, OBER.

unit_economics: Cash = collections - construction - approvals - overheads - tax - land - interest; value = NAV of own-share project DCFs + unlaunched land + capitalised annuity NOI - net debt; reported P&L lags presales by 2-5 years.

price_drivers.why: Pre-sales are the lead indicator for NAV; the 2QFY27 +26% was mostly one project (OBER INR79b) and launches slip, so stock moves on launch grid delivery.
Collections of INR258b at 60% efficiency fund land buys and debt reduction; RERA escrow locks 70% of receipts.

price_drivers.driver: Land and BD replenishment against leverage
price_drivers.why: Developers added INR130b (BRGD) and INR110b (SIGNATUR) of GDV in 2Q; land spend above operating cash surplus raises net debt.
Like-for-like price growth is 1-5% against construction inflation of 3-15% depending on source, setting embedded margin on new launches.
The first RBI hike in Oct-26 and 17-21 months of inventory hit sector multiples before volumes.

kpis.name: Pre-sales value (own share) and volume
kpis.definition: Bookings net of cancellations at economic share, excluding DM, land and inherited bookings, with area and realisation per sq ft.
kpis.formula: Own-share bookings value; value / area sold
kpis.why_it_moves_price: INR428b was +26% YoY but +3% ex OBER; pre-sales are the first print investors read and the metric guidance is set on (LODHA INR240b, BRGD INR90b).
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation metric filter 'pre-sales' or 'bookings' for DLF, LODHA, GODREJPROP, PRESTIGE, BRIGADE, OBEROIRLTY; MOFSL results exhibit 44; transcripts for units and psf.
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus field for pre-sales; company guidance in transcripts; broker models (Nomura top-17 tracker); get_consensus_estimates for revenue and PAT.
kpis.traps: Gross vs own share (DLF Westpark at 100%); DM bookings and data-centre land in presales (LODHA); Oberoi includes stamp duty from Q1FY26; cancellations netted silently.

kpis.name: Collections and operating cash surplus
kpis.definition: Customer receipts for residential and commercial sales less construction, approvals, overheads, selling and tax.
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Collections of INR258b (+14%) turn bookings into cash; DLF's net cash of INR15,084 cr at Sep-26 held INR12,270 cr in RERA accounts, so free cash is much lower.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation metric filter 'collections' and 'cash flow'; MOFSL exhibit 45; get_financials cash flow statement.
kpis.estimate_source: Company guidance on calls; broker models; no consensus.
kpis.traps: Five operating-cash-flow definitions; Brigade total includes lease and hotel receipts; DLF includes rent.

kpis.name: Launches and BD additions (GDV)
kpis.definition: GDV launched in the quarter against the guided grid and GDV of land and projects added.
kpis.formula: Launched GDV / guided GDV; BD GDV added
kpis.why_it_moves_price: FY27 launch pipelines (PEPL INR466b, GPL INR320b, LODHA INR191b, DLF and SOBHA INR180b each) set 2H presales; launch slippage of 3-5 quarters is the main source of estimate cuts.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation metric filter 'launch' and 'GDV'; transcripts for launch quarter by project.
kpis.estimate_source: Company launch guidance in transcripts; broker launch trackers in report library.
kpis.traps: GDV bases (gross, share, incl. DM) differ; renamed projects hide slippage; Oberoi, ABREL defer launches.

kpis.name: Net debt (all-in) and leverage
kpis.definition: Borrowings plus NCDs, deferred land and JV debt at share less cash, with RERA escrow shown separately.
kpis.formula: Net debt all-in / equity; net debt / operating cash surplus
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Land and annuity capex above operating cash surplus is how developers raise leverage; reported net debt omits zero-coupon NCDs and deferred land (Oberoi commitments reached INR5,564 cr).
kpis.history_source: get_financials balance sheet; get_investor_presentation metric filter 'net debt'; annual reports via read_library_document for NCDs and commitments.
kpis.estimate_source: Company debt guidance; broker net-debt estimates; get_consensus_estimates for EPS only.
kpis.traps: RERA cash netted by some; JV debt off balance sheet at GPL; investor CCDs outside net debt (Max).

kpis.name: Embedded EBITDA margin on new pre-sales
kpis.definition: Expected lifetime EBITDA on own-share pre-sales after overheads and selling cost.
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Margins on new launches decide whether EBITDA of INR48b (27% margin) is sustainable as legacy low-cost land such as DLF Gurugram runs off.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation metric filter 'margin' and 'embedded' for DLF and GPL; transcripts.
kpis.estimate_source: Company disclosures; broker NAV models; no consensus.
kpis.traps: DLF's embedded margin is gross before overheads, GPL's is EBIT; landowner revenue gross-up dilutes reported margin.

kpis.name: Annuity NOI, occupancy and exit rent
kpis.definition: Attributable office, mall and hotel NOI with occupancy, rent per sq ft and renewals.
kpis.formula: Contracted rent ex CAM at economic share
kpis.why_it_moves_price: DLF's DCCDL rental exit of about INR68b for FY27 and BRGD's annuity portfolio growing to 12.5msf (INR17b rent by FY29) set the annuity value; a 50bp cap-rate move changes NAV about 6%.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation metric filter 'rental', 'occupancy', 'NOI'; get_financials; transcripts for exit-rent guidance.
kpis.estimate_source: Company exit-rent guidance on calls; broker NAV models; no consensus.
kpis.traps: CAM inside rental EBITDA; equity-accounted DCCDL sits below EBITDA; DLF cut exit-rent guide in one quarter.

kpis.name: Realisation, price growth and unsold inventory
kpis.definition: Pre-sales per square foot like-for-like and months of unsold inventory in the key cities.
kpis.formula: Price growth on same project; unsold units / quarterly sales
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Top-7 ASP up 7% is mostly mix; inventory at 17-21 months and the Oct-26 rate hike limit pricing power, so this decides whether margin expands.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation metric filter 'realisation'; Anarock and PropEquity via sector notes in report library (Axis, Nuvama, JM).
kpis.traps: Area basis (carpet vs saleable) changes psf by 1.6x; launch mix inflates ASP.

macro_inputs.series: RBI repo rate, home-loan rates, 10-year G-sec
macro_inputs.source: Broker sector notes in report library

macro_inputs.series: Anarock and PropEquity sales, launches, inventory months
macro_inputs.source: Sector notes in report library (JM, Axis, Nuvama)
CBRE, Colliers, C&W via broker notes

valuation_anchor: NAV with project DCFs at 11-12.5% cost of equity, unlaunched land at a stated haircut and annuity at 7-8.5% cap rate; premium or discount to NAV judged on BD replication, with P/E and P/B as cross-checks only; REITs (Embassy, Mindspace, Brookfield, Nexus) used for cap-rate read-across.
watch_next_quarter: Per MOFSL, track delivery of the 2H launch pipelines (LODHA INR191b, DLF Mumbai P-2, ABREL Khar in 4Q, PEPL INR466b), BRGD and LODHA against FY27 pre-sales guidance, and collection efficiency (60% in 2Q).
